description: This file serves as a package index for static analysis, indicating primary packages and modules within the Android app project. It contains an object 'PackageIndex' with a method 'references()' that returns an array of key package classes for the UI and data layers.

classes.name: PackageIndex
classes.description: An object that helps static analyzers identify key packages and modules within the app by listing representative classes.

methods.name: references
methods.description: Returns an array of fully qualified class names in key UI and data packages for static analysis purposes.
